name: Annual Investment Program Review
description: Annual review of the investment program based on anticipated cash flow of all District funds (general, capital reserve, bond, etc.), presented to the Board.

preparers.name: Director of Business Services or designee

quote: An annual review of the investment program shall be prepared by the Director of Business Services or designee, based upon the anticipated cash flow of all District funds, i.e. general, capital reserve, bond, etc. The investment program shall be presented to the Board annually.
